name: A Coin On His Mouth
source:
Are you superstitious?

There are many things in life that we can't explain; objects appearing where they shouldn't, voices calling our names, curses cast by evildoers...

The story you will read today is one of them. A mixture of fear and mystery, of a superstition that circulates among funeral home employees and owners.

You will read about the experience of two brazilian coroners who witnessed such an event that marked their lives.

[From [url=https://axelnovelss.itch.io/a-coin-on-his-mouth]Itch.io[/url]]
